gate_rule: f_opt = T_optimizer / T_iteration (per-scene medians). If f_opt < 0.20 on ALL scenes/stages -> DROP_INSUFFICIENT_OPTIMIZER_HEADROOM. If >=0.30 on >=2 scenes -> continue. If >=0.40 -> STRONG_OPTIMIZER_HEADROOM.

room.source: M0_BASELINE_PROFILE (A100, gsplat baseline, room@15001-15000 post-densification, N=933590, 500-iter window)

speed_bound_context.note: Even a visible-skip optimizer (which removes 100% of invisible-Gaussian optimizer work) only reaches 1.006x best-case. AMPS0 BF16 state compression is strictly weaker than visible-skip (it only shrinks bytes of visible states).

gate_evaluation.reasoning: Measured optimizer fraction is 5.94% (full-Adam, room post-densification) and 14% (SH-Adam, all scenes). Both are far below the 0.20 floor. Even the most optimistic visible-skip speed bound is 1.006x. AMPS0 (BF16 state compression, strictly weaker than visible-skip) cannot reach the 1.05x traffic gate.
